svg.title: AP Invoice Intake Agent — AI-Assisted Accounts Payable Automation
svg.desc: Enterprise solution architecture showing a SharePoint invoice entering Power Automate, Azure AI Document Intelligence extracting fields, a deterministic Azure Function applying six rules, clean invoices filing automatically, held invoices routing to a Teams human approval card, Azure OpenAI providing advisory GL suggestions only, and a grounded Copilot Studio interface reading the same SharePoint operational data.
svg.text: AP Invoice Intake Agent — AI-Assisted Accounts Payable Automation
Document AI → deterministic three-way matching → human exception handling → grounded Copilot
“The LLM advises. It never decides about money.”
SIX RULES · IN ORDER · FIRST FAILURE WINS

g.text: Every item code matches a PO line

svg.text: Copilot Studio Agent in Microsoft Teams
Entra authenticated · General knowledge OFF · Grounded in SharePoint
READ · EXPLAIN · QUERY THE AP QUEUE — NOT THE FINANCIAL DECISION ENGINE
The flow and Copilot operate over the same invoice, purchasing, receiving, status, and decision data.
Invoice record · status · exception reason · computed total
GL suggestion · reviewer decision + audit fields
PO number · item code · unit price
POWER AUTOMATE READS + WRITES SHAREPOINT DATA
IMPLEMENTED ARCHITECTURE · AZURE FUNCTIONS (NODE.JS) · POWER AUTOMATE · MICROSOFT 365
